payload.direct_answer: The health service operator must report breaches/incidents to the health-data oversight role within the period set by the Executive Regulations of the UAE Data Protection Law; that period is not stated in the reviewed corpus.

uae_evidence.relevance: Requires the Entity to report breaches/incidents within the designated period defined by Executive Regulations of UAE Data Protection Law.

international_comparison.relevance: Foreign precedent requiring notification to a supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

options: Report the suspected incident to health_data_oversight within the period defined by the UAE Data Protection Law Executive Regulations once that period is identified.
